description: Execution guard policy for P31 governed agent CLI

rules.name: shell-block-at-low-spoons
rules.description: Never execute shell commands at spoon level 1 or below
rules.reason: Shell execution blocked at spoon level 1. Use a read-only tool or rest.

rules.name: mutating-escalation-on-crisis
rules.description: Escalate mutating tools to elicitation when crisis signals are active
rules.reason: Crisis signals detected. Confirm you want to proceed with this action.

rules.name: onchain-write-confirmation
rules.description: Require confirmation for on-chain writes at spoon level 2 or below
rules.reason: Low spoon level. Confirm on-chain write.
